title: The Calibration Scam
logline: A mechanic is extorting pilots by miscalibrating their drives, and a victim wants revenge without involving the law.

roles.description: Greedy, views pilots as walking wallets.
A grimy repair bay on a backwater station.
A hired gun protecting the mechanic.

public_situation: Ships leaving the local repair bay keep experiencing mysterious drive failures, forcing them to pay for expensive rescue tows.
private_truth: The mechanic deliberately installs faulty limiters. They split the rescue fees with a local tow company.

beats.public_change: Another ship breaks down just outside the station limits.

missions.reason: Needs a sealed demand letter delivered to the tow company headquarters to pressure them.
missions.private_fact: The victim plans to use the ledger to blackmail the mechanic, not report them.

beats.public_change: The mechanic realizes the ledger is gone and panics.

missions.reason: Needs high-grade parts delivered to fix the victim's ship for free and hush them up.
missions.private_fact: The parts are stolen military surplus that could get everyone involved arrested.

beats.public_change: The victim confronts the mechanic with the ledger.

missions.reason: Needs the pilot to scan the shop and certify whether the new parts are clean or dirty.
missions.private_fact: The victim will use a dirty scan to bankrupt the mechanic completely.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot certifies the parts are dirty or abandons the mechanic.
resolutions.summary: The mechanic is ruined and arrested. The victim gets their payback but no money.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot certifies the parts are clean.
resolutions.summary: The mechanic pays the victim a fortune in hush money. The scam stops, but the mechanic stays free.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot fails the initial recovery.
resolutions.summary: The mechanic keeps running the scam and gets bolder, and every independent pilot who docks for repairs pays for it.

loose_threads.detail: The tow company's ships bear the insignia of a supposedly defunct mercenary group.
The stolen parts were marked as destroyed in a recent industrial accident.

radio_hooks: Warning to all pilots: unusual number of drive failures reported near station.
Local mechanic shop accused of extortion.

voice_direction.scam_mechanic: Sleazy, overly friendly, always trying to up-sell.
voice_direction.angry_victim: Pissed off, clipped, zero patience for small talk.
